note: Dubuque County Conservation park about 5 mi south of Dubuque off Hwy 52 / Great River Road, on Mississippi River Pool 12, beside the county's marina (fuel dock, slip rentals, concession with showers in its lower level). 45 x 12 ft concrete pads. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30, 50 A/water, showers/dump, ~30% reservable / 70% FCFS (all re-sourced to the county). Added 55 sites, Apr-Nov season, 14-night limit, pit latrine. Waterfront lead riverfront -> riverview: the campground road runs between every site and the river or harbor. Keep.
flags: WATERFRONT lead riverfront -> riverview (downgrade, from the county's campground map PDF plus NAIP): no site has open land to the water. The north loop (sites 31-52, around the shelter) is ringed by its own loop road, with a ~30-40 m tree belt between the road and the Mississippi; the site 41 photo on MyCountyParks looks inland at the shelter and playground with the road behind. Sites 23-30 sit west of the gravel road along the upper (covered-slip) harbor, and sites 1-22 lie along loops behind the road on the lower harbor and the river bank. So the campground road is between the sites and the water: *view at best. The river or harbor is likely visible through the gaps, but no official photo shows it; if that isn't enough for riverview, it is not waterfront.
SITES 55: the map numbers sites 1-55, including tent sites (7, 8 and 53-55 with 20 A electricity). Hookups mix 50 A/water, 30 A/water and 20 A-only; electric 50 is the best tier.
SEASON: written 04-01 to 11-30 from the park's 'April through November' operating hours; no separate campground season is posted.
BOOKING: the 4-day advance requirement is a minimum lead time, not a window, so it is in the booking note only (no field for it).

PIN: stored 42.43260,-90.58620 sits on the upper harbor, between the north loop (~125 m NW) and the southern site loops; under 250 m from both groups, so not changed. Phone 563-556-6745 matches the county's Office Phone (marina 563-556-3416).
